cards.front: Complete the rule: At a stop sign, stop at the.
cards.back: At a stop sign, stop at the clearly marked stop line when one is present.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a stop sign without a stop line.
cards.back: At a stop sign without a stop line, stop before the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a stop sign with neither a stop.
cards.back: At a stop sign with neither a stop line nor a crosswalk, stop before entering the intersecting highway at the nearest point where approaching traffic can be seen.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Yield sign requires slowing and yielding to.
cards.back: A Yield sign requires slowing and yielding to vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection being crossed or on the road being entered.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a Yield sign, stop before crossing the.
cards.back: At a Yield sign, stop before crossing the intersection or entering the highway if that is necessary to yield safely.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Do Not Enter sign prohibits entry to.
cards.back: A Do Not Enter sign prohibits entry to that highway section from the direction being traveled.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A speed-limit sign states the maximum speed.
cards.back: A speed-limit sign states the maximum speed for that road section under ideal driving conditions.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Keep Right of Island sign directs traffic.
cards.back: A Keep Right of Island sign directs traffic to the right of the island or barrier ahead.

decks.module: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: Work zones commonly use orange signs, cones, drums.
cards.back: Work zones commonly use orange signs, cones, drums, barricades or flashing arrow panels to identify the area.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: In a work zone, watch for hazards such.
cards.back: In a work zone, watch for hazards such as uneven pavement, narrow lanes, heavy equipment and gravel.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: Work-zone warning signs.
cards.back: Work-zone warning signs use orange and black.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not move or go around barriers or.
cards.back: Do not move or go around barriers or signs to cross onto a road closed to traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: When a lane-shift sign redirects all lanes, remain.
cards.back: When a lane-shift sign redirects all lanes, remain in the same lane while following its shift.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Be Prepared to Stop sign calls for.
cards.back: A Be Prepared to Stop sign calls for slowing and readiness to stop for road work ahead.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: A slow-moving-vehicle warning calls for reducing.
cards.back: A slow-moving-vehicle warning calls for reducing speed and approaching the vehicle cautiously.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Road Closed sign prohibits entry to.
cards.back: A Road Closed sign prohibits entry to the work zone except by authorized personnel.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: A closure marked Local Traffic Only or Closed.
cards.back: A closure marked Local Traffic Only or Closed to Thru Traffic permits local residential or commercial traffic only when it has a reason to stop within the work zone.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: Properly posted work-zone closure signs prohibit.
cards.back: Properly posted work-zone closure signs prohibit continuous trips through the closed work zone.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: Work-zone speeding fines are increased.
cards.back: Work-zone speeding fines are increased where signs indicate the increase.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: Watch closely for work-zone personnel because they may.
cards.back: Watch closely for work-zone personnel because they may work near traffic during both daytime and nighttime.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: Leave ample space behind the vehicle.
cards.back: Leave ample space behind the vehicle ahead while traveling through a work zone.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: In work zones, allow extra time and.
cards.back: In work zones, allow extra time and reduce distractions such as phones and the stereo.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to work zones and closures

cards.front: Complete the rule: Drivers must obey traffic directions given by law.
cards.back: Drivers must obey traffic directions given by law enforcement officers, highway personnel and school crossing guards.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Motorists must follow directions from.
cards.back: Motorists must follow directions from a school safety patrol official.

cards.front: Complete the rule: School-appointed safety patrol officials identify their duty through.
cards.back: School-appointed safety patrol officials identify their duty through a badge, appropriate clothing or School Patrol insignia.

cards.front: Complete the rule: School safety patrol officials display stop or.
cards.back: School safety patrol officials display stop or other directional signs where schoolchildren cross public roads.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped.
cards.back: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow.

cards.front: Complete the rule: School warning signs.
cards.back: School warning signs may use fluorescent yellow-green.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A warning sign indicates an unexpected condition.
cards.back: A warning sign indicates an unexpected condition that may require slowing or another response.

cards.front: Complete the rule: An Open Range sign identifies an area where.
cards.back: An Open Range sign identifies an area where livestock may roam unfenced and have the right of way.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook's T-intersection warning describes a junction.
cards.back: The handbook's T-intersection warning describes a junction where the driver must turn left or right.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At the T-intersection described by the handbook's warning.
cards.back: At the T-intersection described by the handbook's warning, stop and yield to drivers approaching from either crossing direction.

cards.front: Complete the rule: An intersection or crossroads warning calls for.
cards.back: An intersection or crossroads warning calls for watching for cross-traffic from the road crossing ahead.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Traffic Signal Ahead sign warns of an.
cards.back: A Traffic Signal Ahead sign warns of an upcoming signalized intersection and is used on roads with higher speeds or blocked views of the intersection or signal.

decks.module: Distinguish school, lane and crossing warnings

cards.back: A School Zone sign warns of a nearby school crossing where drivers should watch for children.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Violating a school-zone speed.
cards.back: Violating a school-zone speed limit carries increased penalties.

cards.front: Complete the rule: When moving left near an added-lane area, first.
cards.back: When moving left near an added-lane area, first check that the lane is clear and signal the lane change.
cards.memory_hook: Distinguish school lane and crossing warnings

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Two-Way Traffic sign warns that a divided.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On the main road, a Merging Traffic sign.
cards.back: On the main road, a Merging Traffic sign warns that other vehicles may enter the driver's lane.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Lane Ends or Merge Left sign warns.
cards.back: A Lane Ends or Merge Left sign warns that two lanes become one and that merging traffic must yield.
cards.memory_hook: Distinguish school lane and crossing warnings

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Divided Highway Ends sign warns that opposing.
cards.back: A Divided Highway Ends sign warns that opposing traffic will no longer be separated by a center strip.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a School Crossing warning, watch for.
cards.back: At a School Crossing warning, watch for children, slow down and obey the crossing guard.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Pedestrian Crossing sign warns of crossing pedestrians.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Divided Highway Begins sign warns that a.

decks.module: Share the road and approach hazards

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Share the Road sign below a bicycle.
cards.back: A Share the Road sign below a bicycle symbol warns drivers and bicyclists to share a highway where bicycle lanes are absent.
cards.memory_hook: Share the road and approach hazards

cards.front: Complete the rule: Share the Road signs may be placed where.
cards.back: Share the Road signs may be placed where lanes or shoulders are narrow or traffic volume or speed is high.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The pennant-shaped No Passing Zone sign stands on.
cards.back: The pennant-shaped No Passing Zone sign stands on the left side and warns that passing is prohibited for that lane.
cards.memory_hook: Share the road and approach hazards

cards.front: Complete the rule: A downhill warning directs drivers to check.
cards.back: A downhill warning directs drivers to check their brakes before descending the steep hill ahead.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Slippery When Wet sign warns that wet.
cards.back: A Slippery When Wet sign warns that wet weather may make the road slippery and calls for slowing under those conditions.
cards.memory_hook: Share the road and approach hazards

cards.front: Complete the rule: A railroad advance warning calls for readiness to.
cards.back: A railroad advance warning calls for readiness to stop before the tracks if a train approaches the crossing.
cards.memory_hook: Share the road and approach hazards

cards.front: Complete the rule: An Animal Crossing warning calls for.
cards.back: An Animal Crossing warning calls for watching for animals crossing the highway.
cards.memory_hook: Share the road and approach hazards

cards.front: Complete the rule: A railroad Emergency Notification System sign is posted.
cards.back: A railroad Emergency Notification System sign is posted at or near a crossing and provides the railroad phone number and that crossing's identifying number.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The railroad emergency sign supplies the information needed.
cards.back: The railroad emergency sign supplies the information needed to report an emergency or a warning-device malfunction to the railroad.

cards.front: Complete the rule: White-on-green guide signs provide.
cards.back: White-on-green guide signs provide direction and distance information.

cards.front: Complete the rule: White-on-blue guide signs.
cards.back: White-on-blue guide signs identify motorist services.

cards.front: Complete the rule: White-on-brown guide signs identify cultural.
cards.back: White-on-brown guide signs identify cultural, historical or scenic points of interest.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Barricades may carry flashing.
cards.back: Barricades may carry flashing lights, especially at night.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook describes permanent barricades as red and.
cards.back: The handbook describes permanent barricades as red and white and temporary barricades as orange and white.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Different barricade colors do not change.
cards.back: Different barricade colors do not change the directions their patterns give drivers.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A V-shaped barricade pattern means the road.
cards.back: A V-shaped barricade pattern means the road is closed and traffic cannot proceed farther.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Barricade stripes slanting down toward the left direct.
cards.back: Barricade stripes slanting down toward the left direct traffic past the barricade on its left side.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Barricade stripes slanting down toward the right direct.
cards.back: Barricade stripes slanting down toward the right direct traffic past the barricade on its right side.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Traffic signals, signs and.
cards.back: Traffic signals, signs and pavement markings are traffic-control devices.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Learn to recognize traffic signs by their.
cards.back: Learn to recognize traffic signs by their color, shape and written message or symbol.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Regulatory signs are usually black and.
cards.back: Regulatory signs are usually black and white, although some use red and white.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook says the slow-moving-vehicle sign is used.
cards.back: The handbook says the slow-moving-vehicle sign is used mainly on off-road equipment such as farm and construction vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Speeding, inattention, failure to yield and.
cards.back: Speeding, inattention, failure to yield and improper lane changes contribute to work-zone crashes.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A Low Clearance sign warns of.
cards.back: A Low Clearance sign warns of very low overhead clearance above the highway.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A School Crossing sign may.
cards.back: A School Crossing sign may be yellow or fluorescent yellow-green.
